questions.stem: What are the key similarities and differences between equivalent services from the three cloud providers?
questions.zhStem: 三家云提供商的对等服务之间有哪些关键的相同点和不同点？
options: Only Azure offers managed Kubernetes; AWS and Google Cloud do not
All three offer VMs, PaaS hosting, serverless functions and managed Kubernetes
Google Cloud offers no PaaS app hosting, unlike AWS and Azure
AWS offers no serverless functions, unlike Azure and Google Cloud
questions.explain: All three share the same service models, because AWS, Azure and Google Cloud each offer virtual machines, PaaS app hosting, serverless functions and managed Kubernetes.
questions.zhExplain: 三家共享相同的服务模型，因为 AWS、Azure 和 Google Cloud 都提供虚拟机、PaaS 应用托管、无服务器函数和托管 Kubernetes。

questions.stem: Which Azure service is the direct counterpart of AWS Lambda?
questions.zhStem: 哪个 Azure 服务与 AWS Lambda 直接对应？
questions.explain: Azure Functions is the counterpart, because it is Azure's serverless compute service that runs code in response to events, just like AWS Lambda.
questions.zhExplain: 对应的是 Azure Functions，因为它是 Azure 的无服务器计算服务，像 AWS Lambda 一样按事件触发运行代码。

questions.stem: What are the key similarities and differences between equivalent services from the three cloud providers?
questions.zhStem: 三家云提供商的对等服务之间有哪些关键的相同点和不同点？
options: Only AWS offers a managed relational database service
Azure SQL Database runs MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQL Server in one service
Cloud SQL supports only MySQL, so Google needs one service per engine
RDS and Cloud SQL cover several engines; Azure has one service per engine
questions.explain: Relational databases differ, because Amazon RDS and Cloud SQL cover several engines in one service, while Azure has a separate service per engine.
questions.zhExplain: 关系数据库服务有所不同，因为 Amazon RDS 和 Cloud SQL 在一个服务里支持多种引擎，而 Azure 每种引擎有单独的服务。

questions.stem: What unique features or capabilities may certain services offer compared to their counterparts?
questions.zhStem: 某些服务相比其对等服务可能提供哪些独特的功能或能力？
options: Azure Queue Storage stores Kafka topics as queues
Azure Event Hubs has built-in Apache Kafka compatibility
Azure Logic Apps converts Kafka calls into workflow steps
Azure Synapse Analytics reads Kafka streams directly as tables
questions.explain: Azure Event Hubs is one example, because it has built-in Apache Kafka compatibility, so existing Kafka apps run on it without code changes.
questions.zhExplain: Azure Event Hubs 就是一例，因为它内置 Apache Kafka 兼容性，现有 Kafka 应用无需修改代码即可在其上运行。

questions.stem: How do the naming conventions between cloud providers differ for similar services?
questions.zhStem: 各云提供商之间对类似服务的命名约定有何不同？
options: All three providers use acronyms, but Azure and Google explain them in the portal
Azure and Google Cloud use brand names, while AWS uses descriptive names
AWS uses brand names and acronyms, while Azure and Google Cloud use descriptive names
AWS names describe the job, while Azure and Google Cloud names are codes
questions.explain: The styles differ, because AWS uses brand names and acronyms such as EC2 and S3, while Azure and Google Cloud use descriptive names such as Azure Files and Cloud DNS.
questions.zhExplain: 风格不同，因为 AWS 使用 EC2 和 S3 这类品牌名和缩写，而 Azure 和 Google Cloud 使用 Azure Files 和 Cloud DNS 这类描述性名称。

questions.explain: Azure: No first-party service (Azure Media Services retired in 2024; partner solutions); AWS: AWS Elemental MediaConvert; Google Cloud: Transcoder API.
questions.zhExplain: Azure：No first-party service (Azure Media Services retired in 2024; partner solutions)；AWS：AWS Elemental MediaConvert；Google Cloud：Transcoder API。

questions.stem: A real-time communication service used for sending notifications, emails, and text messages to users and devices. Which Azure service is it?
questions.zhStem: 一种实时通信服务，用于发送通知、电子邮件和短信给用户和设备。Azure 中是哪个服务？
options: Azure Notification Hubs, Azure Communication Services
questions.explain: Azure: Azure Notification Hubs, Azure Communication Services; AWS: Amazon SNS (email: Amazon SES); Google Cloud: Firebase Cloud Messaging (push only).
questions.zhExplain: Azure：Azure Notification Hubs, Azure Communication Services；AWS：Amazon SNS (email: Amazon SES)；Google Cloud：Firebase Cloud Messaging (push only)。
